_comment: Search space for the 5m MA+R:R optimizer. The 7 non-switch tunables are the parameters that cleared a permutation null at z>2 on BOTH the 15m tree (7.2M evals) and the 1h tree (9.9M evals) -- an independent replication across timeframes, which is much stronger evidence than either tree alone. z scores (15m / 1h): hhPivotLen 9.6/5.6, rrRatio 7.7/4.9, volMultMin 4.9/6.6, runMaxPct 4.4/3.2, hlBreakPivLen 2.7/5.1, ma1_slopeLb 2.5/3.4, entryBodyAtrMult 2.0/2.9. useSuperTrend is searched as an explicit on/off so each coin is backtested both with and without the filter; its tuning is frozen in base_params.json. Value LISTS are inherited from the 15m tree (the nearest timeframe) -- they have not been re-tuned for 5m bar counts, so widen them if the winners pile up at a list edge. NOTE: the genome is a POSITIONAL array; editing this file requires a wipe.

objective._comment: score = net_pct - dd_weight*|dd_pct| - overtrade_penalty*max(0, trades-overtrade_cap). min_trades is 80 here vs the 15m tree's 50. It was set empirically, not assumed: over 60 random genomes on 5 coins the in-sample entry count ran p10=78, median=125, max=316, so 80 rejects about 12% of configs as genuinely thin while 100 would have rejected 30%. Note 5m does NOT produce three times the 15m entry count as one might expect -- the HTF filters (MA3/MA4 on 15m, SuperTrend on 1h) gate entries regardless of the chart timeframe. ALLOUSDT is the thinnest coin (median 83, only ~4 months in-sample) and will populate more slowly than the rest.

verify_map._comment: Sanity anchors: input id -> expected dialog label prefix. Bot refuses to run if these do not match (protects against Pine input reordering).
